name: Three Pot
short_description: Runs DSP code from the SD card
description: This algorithm allows you to run what are effectively DSP "plug-ins", loaded from the MicroSD card. It was designed particularly to support programs written for the Spin Semiconductor FV-1 chip. Although the focus is on converted FV-1 programs, the conversion works by translating the programs to C++ and then compiling them for the disting NT – so you can if you like actually write C++ directly and use this algorithm to run it on the module. The name "Three Pot" comes from the FV-1 hardware design – all it has are stereo inputs and outputs, and connections for three pots for user controls.
use_cases: Running FV-1 DSP programs converted to 3pot format
Running custom C++ DSP code on the disting NT
Leveraging the large library of open source FV-1 DSP programs
gui_description: The UI provides a custom display showing the program name, pot labels, and description (all from the 3pot file if provided). The three physical pots on the module control the three pot parameters directly. The right encoder changes the program. While selecting a new program, the whole display is given over to showing the program description.
